summary: Engine-CMS sync implementation is complete and correct. FEAT-001 adds 6 new engine admin read endpoints (GET /admin/flows, /flows/{id}, /flows/{id}/versions, /jdms, /jdms/{id}, /connections/{key}) with proper operator auth, secret redaction, and comprehensive test coverage. FEAT-002 adds the CMS sync layer with AdminClient extensions, sync controller (/sync/status, /sync/import), SyncPanel component, and 10 vitest tests. All acceptance criteria are met: TypeScript types match Go response shapes, no secrets in responses (only secret_ref), all endpoints require operator auth via guard wrapper, tests cover happy path and error cases. Build and all 98 tests pass.
